mapper.select: SELECT id, access_token, token_type, expires_at, created_at FROM codef_access_token ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO codef_access_token (id, access_token, token_type, expires_at, created_at) VALUES (1, #{accessToken}, #{tokenType}, #{expiresAt}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE access_token = #{accessToken}, token_type = #{tokenType}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, created_at = NOW()
